UserData.title: UserData
UserData.description: User profile and complete synced accounting ledger for personal and business finances

userId.description: The unique Firebase Auth User ID

lastSyncedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last successful sync

personalTransactions.description: Complete list of personal expense and income transactions

businessTransactions.description: Complete list of business expense and income transactions

personalBudget.description: Monthly and category budgets for personal finances

businessBudget.description: Monthly and category budgets for business finances

settings.description: User settings such as language, currency, and date format

personalCatOverrides.description: Customized personal categories and budget thresholds

businessCatOverrides.description: Customized business categories and budget thresholds

businessOrders.description: Business sales and customer delivery orders

appLogoFit.description: Logo fit setting: cover or contain

activeMode.description: Active ledger mode: personal or business

otherPersons.description: List of persons for other transactions such as family or third-party accounts (e.g. Shahin, Abba, Amma)

otherTransactions.description: List of deposits and itemized expenses under other persons' accounts

/users/{userId}.description: The root document containing the entire encrypted & verified financial ledger for the authenticated user
